Written to `library/domains/humanities/domains/sociology/domains/work/texts/the-settlement-path.md`.

The text makes one claim: the settlement path is the organizing principle of the 561 system. It defends this by showing the same four-stage structure (inquiry/derivation/procedure/process) recurring in four parallel systems — work taxonomy, formality scale, computation model, automation pipeline — and demonstrating that every piece of infrastructure exists either to perform work at a specific settlement stage or to move work from one stage to the next. The closure structure from the training-as-closure text provides the mathematical grounding: each settlement step is a closure operator, and full settlement is a fixed point.
